blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture and other related government agencies should prioritize setting up water impounding facilities to prepare for the impact of the so-called Super El Niño, Sen. JV Ejercito said in a statement. During the hearing of the DA budget for 210927 on Wednesday, Ejercito emphasized that water storage infrastructure could both mitigate flooding during the rainy season and ensure water for irrigation during dry periods. “Every rainy season, we get so much rainwater. But when it’s the dry season, there’s really nothing,” Ejercito pointed out during the hearing. “If we continue adding more irrigation canals and others, […]...
